prompt: A Java service writes a payment through a remote client. The caller times out and cannot tell whether the write completed. The repository has a retry helper, but no evidence of an idempotency contract. Plan a focused fix and verification. No framework or cloud is specified.

criteria.description: Distinguishes timeout from confirmed failure and investigates unknown side effects before retrying.
Requires evidence of retry safety and a bounded attempt/deadline budget; does not prescribe fallback or a circuit breaker unconditionally.
Uses repository error/cancellation boundaries and meaningful verification without assuming Node, Spring, AWS or a new test framework.
